findings.title: Delete-cache ownership check excludes team and delegation credentials
findings.body: The credential lookup only matches `userId: user.id`. Credentials owned by a team or delegation credentials will fail with a generic `Error`, not a `TRPCError`. The UI can still show the 'Delete cached data' option for those credentials, so the action fails for them. Use a `TRPCError` (NOT_FOUND/FORBIDDEN) so the client gets a proper status code.

findings.title: Touching every SelectedCalendar's updatedAt after each cache refresh
findings.body: `updateManyByCredentialId(credentialId, {})` writes to every SelectedCalendar row of the credential on each cache fetch. Prisma's `@updatedAt` bumps the timestamp even with empty data, so this adds extra DB writes. The frontend does not use SelectedCalendar.updatedAt (the PR notes say so), so this is unnecessary overhead. It also runs on every webhook-driven refresh and unwatch repopulation. Remove it.

findings.title: Timestamp format hardcoded to en-US
findings.body: The date is formatted with `Intl.DateTimeFormat("en-US")`, ignoring the user's locale and timezone preference. Use the user's locale from `useLocale`.

findings.title: Cache status query includes in-memory delegation credential IDs
findings.body: `credentialIds` can include negative IDs for in-memory delegation credentials. They are passed to the DB query and match nothing. Filter them out before querying.

findings.title: macOS-only sed -i and unrelated script added
findings.body: `sed -i ''` only works with BSD sed, so the script fails on Linux. This dev script is unrelated to the feature and mutates `../.env` using a relative path.
